items.title: Widerspruch gegen die Ablehnung der Haushaltshilfe
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026, no separate 'Tag der Aufgabe zur Post' stated, so posting day = document date 19.11.2026. The letter itself states delivery occurs on the 4th day after posting (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X), matching the statutory rule for a social-law body (Krankenkasse). Counting calendar days from 19.11 (not counted): +1=20.11 (Fri), +2=21.11 (Sat), +3=22.11 (Sun), +4=23.11 (Mon) → deemed delivered Mon 23.11.2026. This falls on a working day, so no adjustment is needed (and for a non-tax authority the delivery day would not move even on a weekend/holiday). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 SGG) starts the day after delivery and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 23.11.2026 + 1 month = 23.12.2026 (Wednesday), a normal working day in NW, so the deadline stands.
